recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter-version:\ .([0-9\.]*).*?/\1/p' .github/workflows/release.yml | head -n 1)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter-version:\ .([0-9\.]*).*?/\1/p' .github/workflows/release.yml | head -n 1)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter

flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get

flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64

mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64

mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64

mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

flutter/bin/flutter pub get

flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter

flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform=android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/*arm64*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
